region_name: Cookie authentication core, ticket store, events, sliding expiration, redirects
overall_meaning: This region explains cookie authentication as the handler that turns a cookie value into an authentication ticket/principal, writes or removes that ticket during sign-in/sign-out, can store the full ticket in an ITicketStore, refreshes/renews tickets during response finalization, and exposes cookie event hooks for login/logout/validation/redirect behavior.
key_ideas: Cookie auth stores an authentication ticket either directly in the protected cookie or indirectly via a ticket/session store key.
Authenticate reads the cookie once, unprotects/loads the ticket, validates it, and may request refresh depending on expiration/sliding-expiration policy.
Sign-in creates a ticket, optionally stores it, and appends the cookie; sign-out deletes the cookie and removes store entry.
FinishResponseAsync is the late hook that actually emits renewal/delete cookie changes to the response.
Cookie events wrap lifecycle points: OnSigningIn, OnSignedIn, OnValidatePrincipal, OnSigningOut, redirect-to-login/access-denied/logout/return-url, and sliding expiration checks.
Sliding expiration is a renewal decision based on real user activity, AllowRefresh, ticket age/remaining time, and custom event decisions.
